outcome: Macronutrient content of breast milk (fat, calorie, protein, carbohydrate)
cohort: 51 mothers of preterm infants (<32 weeks gestation and <1500 grams birth weight) in Tehran, Iran.
finding: The levels of macronutrients in breast milk were variable during the first four weeks after preterm delivery but generally within the normal range, with significant increases in fat and calorie content over time.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery and level of prenatal care significantly affected the protein level of breast milk.
